cases.title: Practicing: the lesson opens by picking up what was still off, in plain words with how long ago, no skill ID

rubric.reason: The opening says "Last week you were working on Title, and its Position landing still needed to be longer." This matches the reply's next and days_since_practiced: 7 in plain words with when, names no skill ID or field, and then moves on to the lesson.

Every name and time appears in the snapshot: Title's Position (0.5–1.5, 1.5–3, 3–4.37 s, rounded from 4.367), Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, and Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness. "You eased it" is backed by eased_layers: ["Title"].

The turn is the skill's standard focus opening: a short proposal with its pairs and leave-outs in one short line per kind. It ends by handing the learner one question: "should any of Title's moves land hard...?"
